engine_rule_definitions:
Build references/event_stats.json for the engine from the BTC 1-minute event study (v3).

Releases: CPI, FOMC (scheduled), jobs report (NFP) and PPI, Jan 2018 - Oct 2026.
The engine only offers entries the user's rules allow (nothing from 60 min before to 30 min after a release) and
never holds through another release, so each rule is scored exactly as the engine applies it:
  sweep_reclaim_fade : first 5-minute close from minute 30 to 60 back inside the pre-release hour range after a sweep
                       (both sides swept inside one bar -> no trade) -> fade; 4h time stop.
  breakout_accept    : a 15-minute close at minute 30, 45 or 60 outside that range by 0.2% -> follow; 4h time stop.
  momentum_after_60m : at minute 60, more than 0.3% from the release price -> follow; 24h time stop.
  spike_fade_24h     : at minute 60, a first-hour move larger than 2.5x the median hourly move of the prior 720 clock
                       hours and larger than 0.6% -> fade; stop 0.3% beyond the first-hour extreme; 24h time stop.
All with a stop floor of 1.5% of price (BTC), first target 1.5R, CoinSwitch-like costs (taker 0.055% + 18% GST per
side, slippage 0.10%/side in the first hour, 0.03% after). A trade whose holding window contains another release is
skipped (the engine's rules check would block it).
Verdict support: each cell has a 90% interval, an interval for (event-day minus ordinary-day average R), and an
interval adjusted for the 16 rule x release cells tested (Bonferroni); a POSITIVE verdict needs the adjusted one > 0.

CPI.text: 105 releases: the first 15 minutes moved a median 0.39% (0.16% at the same time on ordinary days); the first hour's range was 1.40% (ordinary 0.80%). The pre-release hour's high or low was swept within 30 min 81% of the time; both sides within an hour 22% (ordinary 13%). The first 15-minute direction still held 4 hours later 43% of the time and had reversed 31%; the release spike was the 24-hour high or low 38% (ordinary 22%). With each rule's own stops, all 6 tested news rules lost money after costs. As the engine trades them (30+ min after, 1.5% stop): sweep reclaim fade -0.21R over 47 trades, breakout accept -0.19R over 62 trades, momentum after 60m -0.28R over 32 trades, spike fade 24h +0.13R over 19 trades. None is proven after allowing for the 80 rule and release combinations tested. With this many releases, edges up to about 0.3R per trade can be neither proven nor ruled out.
